Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{0} = 30.919 + 2.360 \times 10^{-3} T - 2.075 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0}-H_{298}^{0} = 30.919 \times 10^{-3} T + 1.180 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 2.075 \times 10^{2} T^{-1} - 10.019$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-1128 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -318.559 + 10.469 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 5.230 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 249.850 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -318.559 - 10.469 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 5.230 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 124.925 \text{T}^{-1} + 140.080 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1128-1289 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -312.332 - 2.912 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.700 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 105.050 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -312.332 + 2.912 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.700 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 52.525 \text{T}^{-1} + 47.267 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1289-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -316.101 - 2.636 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.700 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 105.050 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -316.101 + 2.636 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.700 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 52.525 \text{T}^{-1} + 52.168 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
